config.baseline_reproducibility: Exact original64/direct/tail head and scalar fit reproduction; RETAINED_TAIL full actions/native states/outcomes reproduce accepted tail report
config.cache: reuse exact prior authenticated497-row feature cache and externally held original binding/evidence; no cache write/copy or trace reconstruction
config.calibration: one fixed weighted minimum-change final-Linear least-squares solve; frozen64-trained hidden features; no parameter selection
config.legacy_admission: original IL world/context envelope authenticates reconstruction only; new actual caps are stricter and independently enforced
config.scientific_scope: One deterministic common-state continuation diagnosis on simulator-generated annotation-assisted TRAIN anatomy; no learned policy improvement, measured surgery or clinical claim
config.selection: Frozen TAIL for8 verified prefix actions; one index8 action fixed per declared treatment; unchanged TAIL thereafter to original absolute horizon24
config.subject: ReMIND-045
config.tail: one fixed float64 weighted SVD minimum-change final-Linear solve about direct-calibrated readout, cutoff1e-8; frozen64-trained hidden layer; target best recorded subsequent prefix with STOP0
config.target: Q_i=r_i+max(0,Q_(i+1)); STOP=0; current negative action cost preserved
config.training: frozen IL64 full policy, separate actor-MLP clone,64 full-batch Adam updates lr.001 clip5; equal subject/trace/state mass; only logged action rows supervised

cost_scope: This common-state pair: exact prior cache load,64 head updates, reproduced direct calibration/tail fit, one045 source visit, two full fresh planning arms including duplicated8-action prefix/scoring, then two independent full route replays. All prior failed cache/direct/tail experiment costs remain separately paid. Inclusive phases overlap; do not sum them.

cumulative_iteration_costs.scope: cache-fill failure plus direct recovery plus tail contrast plus endgame pair; older original64 experiment separate

failure.message: Retained full native history/state projection changed

native_budget.excluded_costs: Shared original preparation, ingress screening, selected initial inventory and independent audit must be reported separately.

native_preview_profile.scope: process cumulative native preview calls, including constructor/fresh/next-inventory work
native_preview_profile.unmeasured: internal preview subphases, bytes copied/hashed, engine initialization and integrity time require separate profiling

native_budget.request_interpretation: Zero-preview returns may be cached, empty or STOP-only; cache hits are not instrumented.
native_budget.wall_limit: Cooperative checks; in-flight native/C work cannot be forcibly stopped here. External process supervision is required.

planning.within_call_costs: clone, full native inventories, immediate scoring, public observations, one Q batch per productive state, commits, integrity checks
